note: BH-9952: the most wall seconds one rung (one candidate's br_one) may run. Past it, the rung's process tree gets TERM (then KILL after BR_RUNG_KILL_GRACE_SECS), the log names reason=rung-bound, the profile row records rc 124, and the tick goes to the next candidate. 0 = no bound (the seed). A kill ends a fix round's paid agent call, so a value under FIX_AGENT_TIMEOUT (3600) loses that spend.
